suggestion: Treat the 13 Nov desk ledger as a superseded snapshot; add a dated capture log with one read time per capture.

suggestion: Owner decision on the compiled-data rights position: (a) keep row tables, (b) publish only counts and links, or (c) seek written permission from the NFL.

cost_estimate: Low to decide; legal cost for (c) not estimated.
risk: Option (a) keeps a compliance risk that the owner would be accepting.
acceptance_test: A recorded owner decision, and the site matches it.
